blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Metro Manila’s improving condominium sales have yet to signal sustained growth, with Leechiu Property Consultants (LPC) cautioning that demand remains heavily supported by developer incentives and government housing programs. In its third-quarter report, LPC said affordability constraints, elevated inventory, compressed rental yields, inflationary pressures, financing costs and political uncertainty could limit the residential […]...
